notes.title: Demo update v1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We've updated our demo version:
[olist]
 Added additional story items and vegetation
 Updated the UI and English localization
 Enhanced some mechanics with new features, greatly aided by your feedback
 Improved the quality of models, effects and audio side
 Fixed a number of bugs
[/olist]
